scope: Exact finite sanity controls, not an obstruction construction or proof of the general Hodge conjecture.
background_policy: Standard projective-space and Grassmannian cycle descriptions are imported mathematical facts, not newly formalized theorems. The checker verifies the stated finite algebra and explicit quadric/plane equations.

references.title: Clay Mathematics Institute: Hodge Conjecture, with official problem description by Pierre Deligne
references.role: Classical rational statement and distinction from the integral variant; reference, not a newly retrieved proof.

references.title: William Fulton, Young Tableaux (1997): Grassmannians and Schubert calculus
references.role: Gr(2,4) Schubert cells and algebraic cycle basis; no page-specific quotation asserted.

references.title: Lefschetz (1,1) theorem
references.role: Imported codimension-one theorem for smooth projective complex varieties; not higher-codimension surjectivity.

references.title: Atiyah and Hirzebruch, Analytic cycles on complex manifolds, Topology 1 (1962), 25–45
references.role: Historical integral counterexamples; not counterexamples to the rational conjecture.

quadric.variety: Q^4 isomorphic to Gr(2,4) in P^5_C
quadric.required_disposition: Reject the naive obstruction: it is nonzero on actual algebraic planes, although it kills h^2. Non-divisor-generated and primitive do not mean nonalgebraic.

rationalization.kind: abstract coefficient diagnostic, not a claimed variety
rationalization.required_disposition: Integral nonmembership and finite torsion alone cannot refute rational cycle-class surjectivity.
